question_en: What are the natural variables of the free energy $F=U-TS$?
question_uz: Erkin energiya $F=U-TS$ ning tabiiy o'zgaruvchilari qaysilar?
question_ru: Каковы естественные переменные свободной энергии $F=U-TS$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. dF = dU − T dS − S dT = −S dT − p dV: differensialda faqat dT va dV qatnashadi.
Asos: erkin energiya differensiali.

distractors_en.E: U is a function, not a variable

question_en: What is the differential of the Gibbs energy $G=U-TS+pV$?
question_uz: Gibbs energiyasi $G=U-TS+pV$ ning differensiali qaysi?
question_ru: Каков дифференциал энергии Гиббса $G=U-TS+pV$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. dG = dU − T dS − S dT + p dV + V dp; dU = T dS − p dV ni qo'ysak, −S dT + V dp qoladi.
Asos: Gibbs energiyasi.

question_en: Which expression equals $\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T$?
question_uz: Qaysi ifoda $\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T$ ga teng?
question_ru: Какое выражение равно $\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. dF = −S dT − p dV: aralash ikkinchi hosilalar tengligidan (∂S/∂V) = (∂p/∂T).
Asos: Maksvell munosabati.

uz: $F\left(T,V\right)$ ning aralash hosilalari: $$\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T=\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V$$
ru: Смешанные производные $F\left(T,V\right)$: $$\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T=\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V$$
en: Mixed derivatives of $F\left(T,V\right)$: $$\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T=\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V$$

rules.uz: Maksvell munosabati: $\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T=\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V$
rules.ru: Соотношение Максвелла: $\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T=\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V$
rules.en: Maxwell relation: $\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_T=\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V$

distractors_en.C: relation from G without its sign

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 4.2.4 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: $3\ \mathrm{mol}$ of an ideal gas increases its volume by a factor of $2$ isothermally at $400\ \mathrm{K}$. What is the greatest work ($\mathrm{kJ}$) the gas can do?
question_uz: $3\ \mathrm{mol}$ ideal gaz $400\ \mathrm{K}$ da izotermik ravishda hajmini $2$ marta oshirdi. Gaz bajara oladigan eng katta ish ($\mathrm{kJ}$) qancha?
question_ru: $3\ \mathrm{mol}$ идеального газа изотермически при $400\ \mathrm{K}$ увеличили объём в $2$ раза. Какова наибольшая работа газа ($\mathrm{kJ}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. T o'zgarmas: A = −ΔF = νRT ln 2 = 3·8.31·400·0.693 ≈ 6.91 kJ.
Asos: erkin energiya va eng katta ish.

distractors.A: ΔU = 0 dan ish nol deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: из ΔU = 0 сделан вывод, что работа ноль

distractors_en.A: ΔU = 0 taken to mean zero work

source: Irodov, «Problems in General Physics», 2.129-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: What is $\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_T$ for $\nu$ moles of an ideal gas?
question_uz: $\nu$ mol ideal gaz uchun $\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_T$ nimaga teng?
question_ru: Чему равна $\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_T$ для $\nu$ моль идеального газа?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. T(∂p/∂T) − p = T·νR/V − νRT/V = 0: ideal gaz energiyasi hajmga bog'liq emas.
Asos: energiya tenglamasi.

rules.uz: Energiya tenglamasi: $\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_T=T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V-p$
rules.ru: Уравнение энергии: $\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_T=T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V-p$
rules.en: Energy equation: $\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_T=T\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial T}\right)_V-p$

distractors_en.D: result for a van der Waals gas

question_en: Express $C_p-C_V$ for any substance in terms of the volume expansion coefficient $\alpha$ and the isothermal compressibility $\kappa_T$.
question_uz: Har qanday modda uchun $C_p-C_V$ ni hajmiy kengayish koeffitsiyenti $\alpha$ va izotermik siqiluvchanlik $\kappa_T$ orqali ifodalang.
question_ru: Выразите $C_p-C_V$ для любого вещества через коэффициент объёмного расширения $\alpha$ и изотермическую сжимаемость $\kappa_T$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Maksvell munosabati bilan C(p) − C(V) = TVα²/κ. Ideal gazda α = 1/T, κ = 1/p — Mayer tenglamasi R chiqadi.
Asos: issiqlik sig'imlari farqi.

en: Check with an ideal gas: $$C_p-C_V=\frac{TV\alpha^2}{\kappa_T}=T\cdot\frac{RT}{p}\cdot\frac{1}{T^2}\cdot p=R$$

distractors.A: α kvadratga oshirilmagan — o'lcham mos emas

distractors_ru.A: α не возведён в квадрат — размерность неверна

distractors_en.E: valid only for an ideal gas

question_en: For a van der Waals gas, by what factor is the low-pressure inversion temperature $T^*$ larger than the critical temperature $T_c$?
question_uz: Van-der-Vaals gazi uchun past bosimdagi inversiya temperaturasi $T^*$ kritik temperatura $T_c$ dan necha marta katta?
question_ru: Во сколько раз температура инверсии $T^*$ газа Ван-дер-Ваальса при низком давлении больше критической температуры $T_c$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. T* = 2a/(Rb), kritik T = 8a/(27Rb); nisbat 2·27/8 = 27/4 = 6.75.
Asos: inversiya temperaturasi.

distractors_ru.D: принято, что инверсия в критической точке

distractors_en.D: inversion assumed at the critical point
distractors_en.E: confused with the critical volume ratio

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 4.2.5 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A system is in equilibrium with surroundings at constant temperature and pressure. Which quantity is a minimum at equilibrium?
question_uz: Tizim o'zgarmas temperatura va bosimdagi muhit bilan muvozanatda. Muvozanatda qaysi kattalik minimal bo'ladi?
question_ru: Система находится в равновесии со средой при постоянных температуре и давлении. Какая величина минимальна в равновесии?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. T va p o'zgarmas bo'lsa, o'z-o'zidan jarayonlarda ΔG ≤ 0, muvozanatda G minimal.
Asos: muvozanat sharti.

distractors_en.B: case of constant T and V
distractors_en.C: case of constant S and p
distractors_en.D: case of constant S and V
distractors_en.E: S is a maximum in an isolated system

question_en: In a two-level system (non-degenerate levels), what does the fraction of particles in the upper level tend to as the temperature grows without limit?
question_uz: Ikki sathli sistemada (sathlar aynimagan) temperatura cheksiz oshirilsa, yuqori sathdagi zarralar ulushi nimaga intiladi?
question_ru: К чему стремится доля частиц на верхнем уровне двухуровневой системы (уровни невырождены) при неограниченном росте температуры?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. T → ∞ da Bolsman faktori 1 ga intiladi, ikkala sath teng band: ulush 1/2. Inversiya musbat T da bo'lmaydi.
Asos: Bolsman taqsimoti.

distractors.B: hamma zarra yuqoriga o'tadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: принято, что все частицы уходят вверх

distractors_en.B: all particles assumed to go up

question_en: In a two-level system $kT=\frac{\varepsilon}{\ln2}$. What fraction of the particles is in the lower level?
question_uz: Ikki sathli sistemada $kT=\frac{\varepsilon}{\ln2}$. Pastki sathdagi zarralar ulushi qancha?
question_ru: В двухуровневой системе $kT=\frac{\varepsilon}{\ln2}$. Какова доля частиц на нижнем уровне?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Bolsman faktori exp(−ln 2) = 1/2, demak N2 : N1 = 1 : 2 va pastki ulush 2/3.
Asos: Bolsman taqsimoti.

distractors_en.A: Boltzmann factor taken as the fraction

question_en: What is the mean energy of a quantum oscillator of frequency $\omega$ when $kT\gg\hbar\omega$?
question_uz: Chastotasi $\omega$ bo'lgan kvant ossilyatorning o'rtacha energiyasi $kT\gg\hbar\omega$ da nimaga teng?
question_ru: Чему равна средняя энергия квантового осциллятора частоты $\omega$ при $kT\gg\hbar\omega$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Kvantlar soni ≈ kT/ħω, energiya → kT: kinetik va potensial energiya — ikki kvadratik had.
Asos: kvant ossilyator.

question_en: In the Einstein model, how does the heat capacity of a crystal depend on temperature for $T\ll\theta$?
question_uz: Eynshteyn modelida $T\ll\theta$ da kristall issiqlik sig'imi temperaturaga qanday bog'liq?
question_ru: Как зависит теплоёмкость кристалла от температуры при $T\ll\theta$ в модели Эйнштейна?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Bir xil chastotali ossilyatorlarda energiya tirqishi bor — issiqlik sig'imi eksponensial kamayadi. T³ — Debay qonuni.
Asos: Eynshteyn modeli.

distractors.E: ikki sathli sistemaning yuqori T dumi

distractors_en.D: the electron contribution in a metal
distractors_en.E: high-T tail of a two-level system

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 4.1.1 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The figure shows the heat capacity of a sample of two-level systems as a function of temperature. What is the level spacing ($\mathrm{meV}$), approximately?
question_uz: Rasmda ikki sathli sistemalardan iborat namuna issiqlik sig'imining temperaturaga bog'liqligi berilgan. Sathlar oralig'i ($\mathrm{meV}$) taxminan qancha?
question_ru: На рисунке дана зависимость теплоёмкости образца из двухуровневых систем от температуры. Каково примерно расстояние между уровнями ($\mathrm{meV}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Cho'qqi 50 K da; Shottki cho'qqisi kT ≈ 0.417ε da: ε ≈ 4.31/0.417 ≈ 10.3 meV.
Asos: Shottki anomaliyasi.

distractors_en.B: kT = ε assumed at the peak

question_en: The temperature of a paramagnet in a weak field is increased by a factor of $2$, the field unchanged. By what factor does the magnetisation change?
question_uz: Kuchsiz maydondagi paramagnetik temperaturasi $2$ marta oshirildi, maydon o'zgarmadi. Magnitlanish necha marta o'zgaradi?
question_ru: Температуру парамагнетика в слабом поле увеличили в $2$ раза, поле не менялось. Во сколько раз изменится намагниченность?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Kuchsiz maydonda tanh x ≈ x, M ≈ Nμ²B/(kT) — Kyuri qonuni: T ikki marta ortsa, M ikki marta kamayadi.
Asos: paramagnetik.

distractors.A: magnitlanish T ga proporsional deb olingan
distractors.E: T² ga teskari proporsional deb olingan

distractors_en.E: taken inversely proportional to T squared

question_en: $N$ independent spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ particles with no field (both states of equal energy) are at temperature $T$. What is their free energy (zero of energy at the states' energy)?
question_uz: Maydon yo'q joyda $N$ ta mustaqil spin $\frac{1}{2}$ zarra (ikkala holat energiyasi bir xil) temperaturasi $T$. Ularning erkin energiyasi qancha (energiya noli holatlar energiyasida)?
question_ru: $N$ независимых частиц со спином $\frac{1}{2}$ без поля (энергии обоих состояний одинаковы) при температуре $T$. Какова их свободная энергия (ноль энергии — на уровне состояний)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Har bir zarra uchun Z = 2, jami Z = 2 darajasi N; F = −kT ln Z = −NkT ln 2. Energiya nol, F = −TS.
Asos: statistik yig'indi.

distractors.A: energiya nol bo'lgani uchun F nol deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: F принята нулём, раз энергия ноль

distractors_en.A: F taken as zero since energy is zero

question_en: The pressure of an ideal gas is increased by a factor of $e$ at constant temperature. By how much does the chemical potential change (answer in units of $kT$)?
question_uz: Ideal gaz bosimi o'zgarmas temperaturada $e$ marta oshirildi. Kimyoviy potensial qanchaga o'zgaradi (javob $kT$ birligida)?
question_ru: Давление идеального газа увеличили в $e$ раз при постоянной температуре. На сколько изменится химический потенциал (ответ в единицах $kT$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. μ = μ0 + kT ln(p/p0): bosim e marta ortsa, logarifm 1 ga ortadi, Δμ = kT.
Asos: kimyoviy potensial.

distractors.A: T o'zgarmas bo'lsa μ ham o'zgarmas deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: принято, что при постоянной T μ не меняется

distractors_en.A: μ assumed constant at constant T

question_en: How can the entropy be expressed as a derivative of a thermodynamic potential?
question_uz: Entropiyani termodinamik potensial hosilasi orqali qanday ifodalash mumkin?
question_ru: Как выразить энтропию через производную термодинамического потенциала?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. dG = −S dT + V dp: dT oldidagi koeffitsiyent −S. B bosimni, D va E hajmni beradi.
Asos: Gibbs energiyasi.

question_en: In the Einstein model, what is the ratio of the molar heat capacity to $3R$ at $T=\theta$, approximately?
question_uz: Eynshteyn modelida $T=\theta$ da molyar issiqlik sig'imining $3R$ ga nisbati taxminan qancha?
question_ru: Каково примерно отношение молярной теплоёмкости к $3R$ при $T=\theta$ в модели Эйнштейна?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. x = 1: e/(e − 1)² = 2.718/2.952 ≈ 0.92 — T = θ da Dyulong–Pti qiymatiga yaqin.
Asos: Eynshteyn modeli.

distractors.C: T = θ da yarmi deb taxmin qilingan

question_en: What is the adiabatic compressibility $\kappa_S$ of a diatomic ideal gas at pressure $10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$ (in units of $10^{-5}\ \mathrm{Pa^{-1}}$)?
question_uz: $10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$ bosimdagi ikki atomli ideal gazning adiabatik siqiluvchanligi $\kappa_S$ ($10^{-5}\ \mathrm{Pa^{-1}}$ birligida) qancha?
question_ru: Какова адиабатическая сжимаемость $\kappa_S$ двухатомного идеального газа при давлении $10^5\ \mathrm{Pa}$ (в единицах $10^{-5}\ \mathrm{Pa^{-1}}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Izotermik siqiluvchanlik 1/p, adiabatik undan γ = 1.4 marta kichik: 1/(1.4·10⁵) ≈ 0.71·10⁻⁵ 1/Pa.
Asos: siqiluvchanliklar nisbati.

question_en: In a hydrogen fuel cell, for the reaction $\mathrm{H_2}+\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{O_2}\to\mathrm{H_2O}$ at $298\ \mathrm{K}$, $\Delta H=-286\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$, $\Delta G=-237\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. What is the greatest fraction of the enthalpy that can become electrical work?
question_uz: Vodorod yonilg'i elementida $\mathrm{H_2}+\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{O_2}\to\mathrm{H_2O}$ reaksiyasi uchun $298\ \mathrm{K}$ da $\Delta H=-286\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$, $\Delta G=-237\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. Elektr ishiga aylana oladigan entalpiyaning eng katta ulushi qancha?
question_ru: В водородном топливном элементе для реакции $\mathrm{H_2}+\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{O_2}\to\mathrm{H_2O}$ при $298\ \mathrm{K}$ $\Delta H=-286\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$, $\Delta G=-237\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. Какая наибольшая доля энтальпии может превратиться в электрическую работу?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. T, p o'zgarmas: foydali ish ≤ −ΔG = 237 kJ; ulush 237/286 ≈ 0.83, qolgan TΔS issiqlik bo'lib chiqadi.
Asos: Gibbs energiyasi va ish.

distractors.A: hamma entalpiya ishga aylanadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: принято, что вся энтальпия переходит в работу

distractors_en.A: all enthalpy assumed to become work
